image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of the top section of a maypole against a clear blue sky. The pole is wrapped in purple and green ribbons near the apex, from which numerous long, colorful streamers (purple, pink, yellow, green, white) cascade downwards. No dancers or base are visible due to the tight framing.

It is unclear how the cascading streamers are physically attached to the central pole beneath the wrapped top section; some appear to emerge from the wrapping without a clear anchor point.
